x: Most of the original nominations of members for the Olympics, for one reason or another came "unstuck" at the final trials, but a new star arose in Bill Lucas to join company with Harry Churcher, Willie Nankeville and Rene Howell.

Congratulations to our old friends the "Poly" on their third place in the "Southern," ably helped by our own Poly member, Jimmy Wood, who was 23rd. Ron Hughes, who was with us during the war, was an excellent fifth and Rene Howell was 160th.

Christmas greetings were received from the undermentioned:—Borlase Hendry (Iraq); Norman and Lilian Shrubb (Trinidad and Tobago); Bill Ashford (Iran); Charlie and Doris Smart (Germany); Albert Boddy; Stan Horton; Rodney Stone; Clarice and Bill Merryman; Fred Clay; Dick Towndrow; Rene Howell; Mr. and Mrs.

…illiamson, and it is pleasing to see these youngsters giving the senior members such a strong challenge. Jimmy Wood and Rene Howell (our Poly members) were also in the field and Bert Footer surprised a few by his forward running.…

In the final they drew lane 4, on the outside, and thanks to an almost super human effort by Alan Sexton, after bad baton handling earlier, won in 45.3 secs. Congratulations Juniors! 2 miles Steeplechase: 1st, Rene Howell, 10 mins. 50 secs.

Walker who won our novice road race last winter, was off 120 yards and running strongly he eventually took the lead followed by Len Marchant and they finished in that order with Rene Howell, our Poly. member, third off 160 yards.
Arthur Bruce also ran well to " clock " second fastest time, while third fastest was accomplished by Rene Howell, our second-claim Poly. member.
In the recent Civil Service cross-country championship, Derrick Burfitt was placed 3rd, with Eric Herbert 7th, Jack Brown 9th and Rene Howell 11th.

Other members of the British team had been Belgravians during the war including Doug Wilson, Rene Howell and Jack Braughton. Among the visiting teams Canada had a Belgravian as team manager but the Belgian marathon bronze medallist Etienne Gailly became one of the heroes of 1948.
